Little known fact:

The modern AI boom traces back to a 1983 Canadian research bet.

That year, the government backed the creation of the Canadian Institute for Advanced Research (CIFAR) with ~CAD $50M, a major investment at the time.

CIFAR funded long-term work in:
• AI
• Neural networks
• Cognitive science
• Computer science

When neural networks fell out of favor in the U.S., Canada kept funding the researchers who would later drive the deep learning breakthrough including @geoffreyhinton and @Yoshua_Bengio.
